name: Custard Pie
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Beat eggs slightly, add sugar, salt, and milk.
Line plate with paste, and build up a fluted rim.
Strain in the mixture and sprinkle with few gratings nutmeg.
Bake in quick oven at first to set rim, decrease the heat afterwards, as egg and milk in combination need to be cooked at low temperature.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
